The unchanged frozen analyser and comparator consume the view. The separate generation audit consumes original native evaluations, or original API receipts with recovery chains resolved.

API recovery receipts count as existing observations, not new calls. Distinct original response identities remain distinct even when complete request hashes are equal.

crossjudge_command_note: Use native_judge_analysis_view_v1 as the native results input to unchanged judge3_compare. Include the view provenance and this amendment with the resulting report.
